facts.business: Alkosign Limited manufactures boards, benches, and luggage products, with the luggage division discontinued effective February 2, 2026.

auditor.name: K.S. Shah & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of matter regarding discontinuation of Luggage division effective 2nd February 2026 per AS 24; opinion not modified.

key_risks: Intense competition leading to discontinuation of Luggage division
Related party transactions with Senate Office System
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for related party transactions with M/s Senate Office System (Proprietorship Firm) for purchase/sale of manufacturing products (boards, benches, etc.) up to Rs 15 crore for FY 2026-27 at arm's length and in ordinary course of business.
